address: 70 route des Crus-du-Beaujolais (Le Plâtre-Durand), Saint-Amour-Bellevue, 71570, France
bio: Two restaurants in one! Chez Lucienne showcases a concise array of creative often spicy dishes to share: free-range chicken kebab marinated in ras-el-hanout; lamb gyoza in herbs and curry, leeks and soy mayonnaise; deep-fried scallops and tikka masala girolles pickles. On the other hand, Joséphine à Table features a wine bar with traditional starters and a dish of the day (marbled ham, pork pie, chicken kebabs, rice pudding). Both establishments boast a pleasant patio and a friendly, buzzy vibe – all of which washed down with tipples from Mâcon and Beaujolais and a range of wines by the glass from a magnum. Fans of Sunday brunch should make a beeline for chez Lucienne....
